antiSnipe: A bid in the last {window} moves the end to {extend} after that bid. The end can move by at most {max} in total.
keepUsdc: Keep enough USDC in your wallet until the end. It is checked when you bid and again when you pay.
calendar: Add the current end to my calendar

picker.liveHint: A room with a clock for every card. Several cards, one after the other.
picker.timedHint: One card that stays open for hours or days. Bidders come back whenever they like.
picker.oneCard: A timed auction has exactly one card, and you have picked {count}. Go back and pick one card.
picker.limit: For now, timed auctions are open to the Hammerprice room and to operator wallets. With any other wallet, publishing is declined.
picker.rules: A bid in the last {window} moves the end to {extend} after that bid, by at most {max} in total.
picker.settle: After the end, the winner has {time} to pay. The seller must be online to sign when the winner pays.
